newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Plywood maker Ta Fu seen pricing at HK$1.01/share.
newsitem.headline: Plywood maker Ta Fu seen pricing at HK$1.01/share.

text.p: Taiwan-based plywood manufacturer Ta Fu International Holdings Ltd is expected to price its shares at HK$1.01 each in its initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong, market sources said on Friday.

Ta Fu is expected to issue 168 million shares, representing 20.3 percent of its issue share capital, to raise net proceeds of about HK$145 for expansion of its manufacturing facilities in China, market sources said.
The IPO is expected to run from December 16-19, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on December 27, they said.

"About HK$106 million of the proceeds will be used to fund its contribution to its plywood manufacturing joint ventures in China and the remaining HK$39 million will be for working capital," one analyst said after a presentation on Friday.
Ta Fu forecast a profit of about US$9.2 million for the year ending December 31, 1996. It posted a profit of US$7.5 million in 1995, US$4.0 million in 1994 and US$4.4 million in 1993.
Credit Lyonnais and OCBC are expected to be the sponsors of the issue, sources said.
